data.name: Hotel Boutique Le Reve Hotel
data.address: Orrego Luco 023, 7510105 Providencia, Región Metropolitana, Chile
data.description:
A 4-minute walk from the closest metro station, this polished boutique hotel on a tree-lined street is 4 km from the Chilean National Museum of Fine Arts, and 5 km from the 19th-century La Moneda Palace.
Featuring tufted headboards, the elegant rooms come with free Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and laptop-sized safes. Upgraded rooms provide balconies or terraces, while suites add minibars and/or living areas.
Complimentary perks include a breakfast buffet served in a refined dining room or in a courtyard garden, and evening snacks and coffee offered in a kitchen. There's also a cozy self-service bar.
